name: marcel-figma-plugin
description: DesignOps Figma plugin for the Marcel Design System

scripts.check:dist: node -e "require('fs').existsSync('dist/main.js')||(console.error('\n[Marcel] dist/main.js missing — run: npm run build\n'),process.exit(1))"
scripts.postinstall: node -e "require('fs').existsSync('dist/main.js')||console.warn('[Marcel] No build yet — run: npm run build before loading the plugin in Figma.')"
